**Agent Name:** Planner  
**Step Number:** 10  
**Reason for Mistake:** The Planner incorrectly categorized "Cantora 1" and "Cantora 2" as a single studio album, treating them as a "double-album studio project." This error occurred due to a misinterpretation of the visible data from the Wikipedia page, where "Cantora 1" and "Cantora 2" were distinctly listed as two separate studio albums with their own release years (both in 2009). Proper verification was not carried out to ensure the count adhered to the explicit distinction of individual albums.
